topics.definition: Kubernetes security protects clusters, workloads and data from unauthorized access.
tips: Apply the principle of least privilege.

topics.definition: Service Accounts provide identities for Pods to interact with the Kubernetes API.
tips: Create separate accounts for different workloads.

topics.definition: RBAC controls user and service account permissions.
Secrets securely store sensitive information such as passwords and API keys.
tips: Avoid storing secrets in plain text.

topics.definition: Pod Security defines restrictions to improve workload security.
A Security Context defines security settings for Pods and containers.
tips: Run containers as non-root whenever possible.

topics.definition: Admission Controllers validate or modify requests before they are stored in the cluster.
tips: Use admission policies to enforce standards.

topics.definition: Protect clusters using RBAC, Secrets, secure Pods and continuous monitoring.
